name: print-social-audio-product-launch-posts-blue-pixel-checker-earbuds
title: 'Visit The Product Launch!' audio pack in royal blue with pixel checker corners and earbud product photos
whatItMeans: Clean and premium; pixel checker corners give a straightforward product launch a distinct, techy signature.
whatItIs: Five royal blue square posts with white pixel-checkerboard corner patterns, a small asterisk logo, photos of wireless earbuds and headphones, bold headlines ('Visit The Product Launch!', 'The Future of Audio', 'Opening Discount'), dates, venue details and pricing ('$149', '$499').
techniques: Use a small pixel checkerboard pattern as a consistent corner motif.
Pair product photography with clear pricing on dedicated cards.
Keep one saturated blue as the entire set's base colour.

vocabulary.definition: A small grid of alternating filled squares used as texture.
A card pairing a product name with its price.
